name: Boîte chaude
notes: Gluey. Lightly salted. Calm without being upsetting. Tame fun (that doesn't last). Like meeting the girlies with newborns you haven't seen in a while

name: Mango and Ginger White Stilton
notes: Panacotta mango. Pitfruit tones (apricot). Sickly. It says, "Not sure if I like cheese but I like yoghurt"

name: Camambert du Bocage
notes: Baked it and dipped into it. Brilliant creamy smoothness.

name: L'ecir de L'aubrac
notes: "Soft, feminine, floral. White girl in green house about the orient."
"Im getting plaster... wall plaster in particular."
"Watered down brie...  the linger. Gayish."
"Not goat forward, but goat backwards... goat on the back."

name: Ecir Frais Emballé
notes: "Denser than you'd expect."
"Cheesecake. Cream cheese? It is cream cheese. Maybe a cashew."
"Quite fun and unassuming."
"A crowd please... a cheese for the masses. Art Basel reception cheese".

name: Rocamadour Fermier
notes: "It reminds me of Lunchables, bitter lunchables."
"Almond."
"Bitter, yes, that's what I said: alkali"
"Charred French cheese."

name: Roquefort La Cave (Wedge)
notes: "It tells you a story."
"It's got pops of mould."
"I'm getting onion soup... in beef stock"
"You're eating cheese then you get a salmon egg."
"Yeah, bleu cheese to me. makes me wanna crumble it up and put it in a salad."
